payload.message: PR agent poll tick. (1) If the oclaw-pr-agent repo is absent from the workspace, clone https://github.com/eformat/oclaw-pr-agent (branch main); otherwise git pull --ff-only it. (2) cd into the repo root and follow skills/pr-agent/POLL.md exactly — start with scripts/pr_tick.sh. (3) Dry-run is the default: perform GitHub mutations only when this tick is a live tick. (4) For each READY-TO-MERGE finding, follow skills/pr-done/SKILL.md guards before any merge. (5) End with the tick summary (created / claimed / ready-to-merge / cancelled).
